evidence_class_note: A measurement of native Claude Code and Codex transcripts by this repository's own tools. No model was run for it: the only native command, /skill-doctor, is a local command (total_cost_usd 0, num_turns 0).
tool_bytes_note: The tools ran from the change that adds them, before its commit; the sha256 values identify the exact bytes, which that change commits unchanged.

steps.output: (not retained: the raw capture carries a session id)

steps.command: python3 tools/skill-usage/skill_usage.py --claude-skill-doctor <outside the checkout>/skill-doctor.json --codex-root <codex home>/sessions --json --out <outside the checkout>/skill-invoke-rate.json

reproduction.rerun: The final tools produced claude-lanes.json and codex-lanes.json at 17:06Z and again at 17:08Z; the groups (and Codex user_config) were identical. A run of the pre-review tools at 16:39Z gave the same groups except two figures the review round corrected: Claude curl/wget counts (630 -> 614 and loopback-only 100 -> 96 once quoted text and heredoc bodies stopped counting) and Codex worker tool calls (2,688 -> 2,686 once a function_call sharing its call_id with an item stopped counting twice). Capture-time fields (generated_at, rtk_db.rows, transcripts_found, transcripts_skipped_unmodified, files_scanned, files_skipped_unmodified) differ by design, and skill-invoke-rate.json is a capture-time snapshot, not windowed.
reproduction.cross_check: cross-check.json, from a separate implementation, equals the reports on every figure it computes: Claude children 639 (42 Agent-tool, 597 workflow), Bash calls 24,776, RTK decisions (ask 8,325, defer 16,290, deny 137, not logged 24), Skill calls 353, MCP calls per server, the marker in 42 first prompts (all Agent-tool); Codex sessions split by the marker in developer messages 132 / 107, the same split the skill-catalog classification gives, with equal MCP calls per server, shell calls (482 / 110), rtk-prefixed shell calls (195 / 64) and hosted page opens (5 / 1,006).

privacy: Every retained file holds names, counts and token figures only: no host paths, session, run, agent or tool-use ids, labels, prompts or transcript text. Sessions appear as ordinals (session-01 ... session-07) in order of their earliest child row in the window. Paths in commands are placeholders.
